cohort_role: Fixed first evaluation on these sessions; no model fit or threshold search
contract_rule: Use only dated 6EU5 for every selected day; verify daily symbol mapping; no continuous-contract stitching or volume-based roll selection
ofi_definition: Sum completed-event best bid/ask queue changes using the Cont price-change indicators; divide by current mean best-side depth
weighted_mid_definition: (ask*bid_size+bid*ask_size)/(bid_size+ask_size); a queue proxy, not a fitted microprice model or independent queue confirmation
primary_rule: Normalized OFI magnitude >=1 and queue-weighted mid offset magnitude >=0.15 ticks, with matching signs
control_rule: Queue-weighted mid offset magnitude >=0.15 ticks, without the OFI gate; independent position schedule
exit_rule: First clean completed quote at/after entry+15s; if more than 1s late, retain and flag late exit; never drop an entered position for quote timeout
window_end_rule: Any entered position without exit before 16:00 remains unresolved and blocks any positive research conclusion
episode_rule: One selected counterfactual per contiguous signal-direction run; one open primary position per strategy
source_quality_rule: Abort whole run on source hash/mapping/quality failure; no successful-subset report and no automatic threshold relaxation
